title: Bitcoin Price Freefalls Down to $91,0000 and New Lows
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Bitcoin Price Freefalls Down to $91,0000 and New Lows Bitcoin price has fallen nearly 30% from its early October peak near $126,000, trading in the $92,000–$95,000 range as investors weigh Fed uncertainty and missing economic data. This post Bitcoin Price Freefalls Down to $91,0000 and New Lows first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
